TYPE CHECK: The candidate value "human cell line" describes a category of immortalized cells, which fits the field definition.
SOURCE CHECK: The text mentions "phosphopeptides enriched from a human cell line" in the context of reanalysing published data to benchmark Mascot Percolator, but the primary experiment of the paper uses *Plasmodium falciparum* parasites.
TRUTH CHECK: While a human cell line was used for a benchmarking re-analysis, the main proteomics experiment was performed on *P. falciparum* schizonts. COMPLETENESS CHECK: The full set contains only this generic value, but it fails to identify the primary biological source of the study (*P. falciparum*).
